caption: The drawing features three objects arranged on a light beige background. On the left side, there are two circular metallic objects, each with a ridged edge and bronze-brown color. The top circular object displays the profile of a head in relief, while the lower circular object is inscribed with the words "ONE CENT" surrounded by a decorative border. These two circles are vertically aligned and separated by a pair of dotted vertical lines. On the right side, there is a metallic tool, consisting of a long, slightly curved gray handle that ends in a two-pronged fork at the bottom. At the top of the handle, there is a circular, gear-like metallic piece similar in appearance and color to the two circular objects on the left. The composition of the drawing is simple, with the objects and tool rendered in shades of bronze, brown, and gray, and with no background elements or embellishments. The artist's signature, Samuel O. Klein, is located in the lower right corner of the image.
title: Pie Crust Crimper
